name: Lovart
summary: AI design agent for brand identities, posters and videos.
description: Lovart is a design agent: describe a project such as a logo, poster, campaign or packaging and it plans and produces the visuals on a canvas, combining several image and video models. Every element stays editable.
features: Lovart is an AI product for design.

howToUse.title: Sign up on Lovart
howToUse.description: Create an account at the official URL if you need saved work or billing.

howToUse.title: Complete onboarding
howToUse.description: Follow the product tour or connect the first integration it asks for.

howToUse.title: Run a first task
howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.title: Review outputs
howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.

features_fr: Lovart est un produit d'IA pour le design.
summary_fr: Agent de design IA qui crée identités visuelles, affiches et vidéos.
description_fr: Lovart est un agent de design : on décrit un projet (logo, affiche, campagne, packaging) et il planifie puis produit les visuels sur un canvas, en combinant plusieurs modèles d'image et de vidéo. Chaque élément reste modifiable.
